description: Relynx AI Test Agent evaluation dataset.
labelPolicy: Every label records how it was produced (constructed | observed-controlled-variation | author-judgment) and its review status. No label is human-reviewed yet: a person must review a case and set review.status to "human-reviewed" with reviewer and date. Reports count reviewed and pending labels separately.

changelog.changes: Phase 2: 15 planning cases, 10 generation cases, 8 labelled report tests.

Phase 3: label provenance and review status; 6 planning cases (multiple criteria, input validation, conflicting, untestable); 9 assertion-quality cases; 4 seeded-defect functional suites (29 reference outcomes); 10 more real failure captures; failure taxonomy aligned with the Phase 3 categories.
